description: Defines classes for Bluetooth data record handling, including Buffer and DataRecord variants with endian support.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A byte buffer class derived from std::basic_string<uint8_t> with a ToString method.

classes.name: DataRecord
classes.description: A byte order neutral class for managing data buffers with read/write capabilities.

classes.name: DataRecordBE
classes.description: Endian-specific subclass for big-endian data handling.

classes.name: DataRecordLE
classes.description: Endian-specific subclass for little-endian data handling.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts buffer data to a hex string representation.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns new data buffer and updates internal state.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write offset by a specified length.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Fills a section of the buffer with a specified value.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes various data types into the buffer.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Extracts data from the buffer into various types.
